study: Vignoles et al. 2015 (EEF Mathematics Mastery Primary; UCL IoE eval)
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix of in-person and online: teachers received 1-2 days of (face-to-face) launch training, two in-school development visits, and three multi-school cluster workshops, plus access to an online toolkit with continuous CPD; the report states collaboration 'is both face-to-face and online' (Intervention/support diagram, p.10-11).
test_alignment_evidence: Sole included outcome is the Number Knowledge test (Okamoto & Case / Number Worlds, Clark University), an independently published externally-validated maths instrument NOT specific to Mathematics Mastery (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; p.11-12; Table 4).
curriculum_evidence: PD is bundled with adopting a specific new curriculum: Ark Mathematics Mastery, a whole-school 'mastery' maths curriculum delivered by class teachers, with schools receiving 'training and resources to support the adoption of the programme'; the report notes it 'involves a change to the maths curriculum within schools' / a 'specified curriculum at a particular pre-determined pace' (Intervention, p.8-11).
outcome_timing_evidence: Number Knowledge test measured at the end of one year of implementation (immediate post-test; spring/summer 2013 Cohort A, 2014 Cohort B); the extracted pooled headline effect is from this post wave, no delayed follow-up (extraction timepoint 'post, end of Year 1'; Table 4).
